newsitem.title: CANADA: Edper ratings to improve on merger - CBRS.
newsitem.headline: Edper ratings to improve on merger - CBRS.

text.p: Canadian Bond Rating Service said on Thursday that a proposed merger between Edper Group Ltd and Brascan Ltd will have a positive effect on the ratings of Edper.
The Montreal-based ratings agency said the merger will likely have a neutral effect on Brascan's earnings.
CBRS said in a statement that the deal will increase Edper's asset base by about C$2.0 million, raise the market capitalization to about C$4.1 billion from C$2.2 billion.
It said Edper's cash flow will also increase by at least C$65 million.
On April 29 Edper and Brascan announced that they intended to seek shareholder approval to change the ownership of Brascan, so that Brascan will become a wholly owned subsidiary of Edper.

CBRS currently rates Edper Group commercial paper at A-2 (high), senior debentures B++, subordinated debentures B++ (low), subordinated convertible auction notes (SCAN I) B+ (high), subordinated convertible adjustable rate notes (SCAN II) B+ and preferred class A and AA at P-3 (low). All the ratings were given a positive rating outlook.

CBRS said it currently rates Brascan's commercial paper at A-1 (low), term debentures at B++(high), US$300 million shelf prospectus filing at B++(high) and preferred shares (1976 and 1981 series) at P-2 (low). All the ratings were given a stable outlook.
